notes: Added remaining stories to complete revocation, validation integration, and test coverage.

change_log.note: Added integration with GPTReader auth flow

stories.title: Token Revocation Logic
stories.description: Implement explicit token revocation including setting revoked_at, cascading invalidation for rotated child tokens where applicable, and ensuring revoked tokens are rejected during all authentication checks.

stories.title: Authentication Middleware Integration
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle checks (expiration, revocation, rotation lineage) into GPTReader authentication flow to ensure every request validates token status before granting access.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering token issuance, rotation, expiration, revocation, and invalid token access scenarios, including edge cases such as replay attempts and rotated token reuse.
